findings.issue: Secrets written to .env file via heredoc in SSH script — exposed in CI logs if script fails
findings.impact: If the SSH step fails or is debugged, ALL production secrets (Supabase keys, VAPID keys, LiveKit keys) are visible in plaintext in CI logs
findings.fix: Pass secrets to the droplet via environment variables or GitHub Actions secrets injection at compose time; use docker compose --env-file with GH secret masking

findings.issue: Secrets written to .env file via heredoc with conditional injection — potential secrets leakage in logs
findings.impact: Development secrets visible in CI logs if debug enabled or SSH command errors
findings.fix: Use docker compose environment variables or GH Actions secrets injection instead of heredoc; set secrets only at container runtime

findings.issue: No path filtering on push to main — triggers full deploy on any file change
findings.impact: Documentation or config changes trigger expensive Terraform provision + Docker build + deploy cycle unnecessarily
findings.fix: Add paths filter to restrict deploy on push to relevant directories: apps/api/**, apps/web/**, apps/worker/**, infra/docker/**, .github/workflows/deploy-production.yml

findings.issue: Platform workflow runs pwsh script from automation dir — no input validation or scope limiting
findings.impact: Any workflow_dispatch caller can execute arbitrary pwsh scripts with GITHUB_TOKEN that has packages:write scope
findings.fix: Add explicit permissions block restricting token, add environment gates, validate inputs

findings.issue: No explicit artifact retention period set for test-results and coverage artifacts
findings.impact: Artifacts retained indefinitely by default, consuming GH Actions storage quota
findings.fix: Add retention-days: 7 to all uses of actions/upload-artifact

findings.issue: Governance workflow has no explicit permissions block (inherits default write-all)
findings.impact: GITHUB_TOKEN has more permissions than needed, potential supply chain risk
findings.fix: Add explicit permissions: contents: read at the workflow level

findings.issue: No WebSocket reconnection E2E test exists
findings.impact: Reconnection logic (banner, auto-reconnect, message delivery after reconnect) is untested end-to-end
findings.fix: Add E2E test that stops/restarts API server during test and verifies reconnection UI + message flow

findings.issue: File upload E2E test skipped without test-signin.json — never runs in CI
findings.impact: File upload flow is completely untested in CI
findings.fix: Use Supabase admin API test user setup or mock file upload endpoint for CI execution

findings.issue: No E2E tests for permission-denied or error states
findings.impact: Error UX (403/404 handling, read-only channel, non-member access) is completely untested
findings.fix: Add tests for 403/404 error handling, read-only channel send attempt, non-member channel access

findings.issue: Only 2 integration tests exist — both for health endpoints only
findings.impact: API contract changes (messages, auth, channels, notifications, etc.) have no automated validation
findings.fix: Add API integration tests for all CRUD endpoints: auth, messages, channels, workspaces, notifications, flags, pins

findings.issue: Visual snapshot tests exist but are not integrated into CI pipeline
findings.impact: Visual regressions go undetected in CI — no baseline comparison
findings.fix: Add visual snapshot CI job with baseline comparison and diff threshold

findings.issue: Chaos tests are shell scripts with no CI integration or runner
findings.impact: Resiliency coverage is only manual — no automated validation
findings.fix: Integrate chaos tests with CI: run api-crash.sh and verify reconnection and graceful degradation

findings.issue: k6 load tests exist but are only on schedule/manual, not in CI on push
findings.impact: Performance regressions go undetected until scheduled load test run
findings.fix: Run k6 smoke test (low load) in CI on every push to main/develop

findings.issue: No accessibility E2E tests — no axe-core or pa11y integration
findings.impact: Accessibility regressions only caught by manual audit — no automated regression detection
findings.fix: Add @axe-core/playwright to E2E suite and run a11y checks on critical pages

findings.issue: No offline/online state E2E tests
findings.impact: Offline UX (queued messages, reconnection banner, retry logic) is untested
findings.fix: Use Playwright context.route interception to simulate network failures and offline state

findings.issue: Low component unit test coverage — only one __tests__ directory exists
findings.impact: Component-level regressions may slip through
findings.fix: Set minimum 30% coverage threshold for new components; add tests for state-heavy components

findings.issue: E2E tests use fixed timeouts without smart async waiting for WebSocket/optimistic UI
findings.impact: Tests may fail intermittently in CI due to timing issues
findings.fix: Use waitForResponse API interceptors for async operations instead of fixed timeouts

findings.issue: Visual snapshot tests exist only for login page — no empty-state snapshots
findings.impact: Visual regressions in empty states go undetected
findings.fix: Add snapshot tests for empty states: no messages, no channels, no search results

findings.issue: No API integration tests for search, notifications, reactions, or admin endpoints
findings.impact: Backend search, notification, and admin logic is untested
findings.fix: Add integration tests for search API, notification preferences CRUD, and admin endpoints

findings.issue: No backup volume configuration or backup service defined for production data
findings.impact: Redis data and Caddy certs have no automated backup; loss of volumes = data loss
findings.fix: Add automated backup volume to production compose or document manual backup procedure

findings.issue: Dev environment has no explicit mem_limit on services unlike production
findings.impact: Dev environment may over-consume droplet resources, masking OOM issues in production
findings.fix: Add matching mem_limit values to dev compose for api (192m), worker (128m), web (256m), redis (64m), caddy (64m)

findings.issue: Worker healthcheck port (4100) not exposed in Dockerfile EXPOSE or compose ports
findings.impact: Health check works via internal network but container metadata incomplete
findings.fix: Add EXPOSE 4100 to worker Dockerfile for consistency

findings.issue: Production compose uses :latest tag as fallback; deploy overrides to SHA but :latest not uniquely pinned
findings.impact: Manual compose up could pull stale images if deploy script not run
findings.fix: Remove :latest defaults from production compose; require explicit SHA tag via .env

findings.issue: Dev compose uses :dev tag fallback; deploy pulls SHA tag and retags to :dev — potential race
findings.impact: Race condition between build-push completing and deploy pulling :dev before retag
findings.fix: Use SHA tag directly in dev compose via WEB_IMAGE env var, remove :dev fallback

findings.issue: Dev LiveKit config uses localhost for TURN domain while prod uses DOMAIN variable
findings.impact: Dev TURN may not work correctly for external clients testing WebRTC
findings.fix: Use ${DOMAIN:-localhost} for dev LiveKit TURN domain matching prod pattern

findings.issue: No documented policy tier inheritance hierarchy; 4 standalone policy files with no parent chain
findings.impact: Policy changes must be duplicated across files; risk of drift between dev/rc/prod policies
findings.fix: Define base policy defaults in a gate-policy.base.json with per-tier overrides; document inheritance chain in README

findings.issue: Hotfix policy file exists but no documented compensating controls or post-hotfix validation requirements
findings.impact: Hotfix path could become permanent bypass; no mandatory post-mortem or re-validation after hotfix
findings.fix: Add compensating controls section: mandatory peer review, 24h post-mortem, re-apply full gate within 7 days

findings.issue: Governance workflow is a thin wrapper calling external pwsh script with no audit trail of policy decisions
findings.impact: Policy evaluation results not captured as deploy artifacts; no traceability for compliance
findings.fix: Add policy evaluation output to workflow logs and upload as build artifact; capture decision summary

findings.issue: No documented mapping between environments and policy tiers (which policy applies to which workflow/branch)
findings.impact: Operators unclear which gate policy applies to deploy-development vs deploy-production vs hotfix flows
findings.fix: Add workflow-to-policy mapping table in policy directory README or docs/runbooks/release-process.md

findings.issue: No verified per-item ok/error result pattern in bulk endpoints — likely single-status responses
findings.impact: Partial bulk failures appear as full successes to the client; user sees fake success toast on half-failed writes
findings.fix: Audit all POST/PATCH/PUT endpoints that accept arrays; return { results: [{ ok: boolean, error?: string }] } per item

findings.issue: No systematic pattern for displaying partial-failure toasts from bulk API responses
findings.impact: Users not alerted about individual item failures in batch operations
findings.fix: Create a BulkOperationResult component that displays success count vs failure count with details

findings.issue: Each processor has its own AbortSignal.timeout(30s) but no centralized timeout wrapper in task execution
findings.impact: Inconsistent timeout enforcement across processors; new processors may forget timeout handling
findings.fix: Create a createTaskWrapper utility in worker that enforces per-task timeout, retry, and error handling consistently

findings.issue: Circuit breaker status changes logged but not exported as Prometheus metrics
findings.impact: No monitoring/alerting on circuit breaker state; open circuit not visible until users report failures
findings.fix: Export circuit breaker state (open/closed/half-open) as prometheus gauge per breaker name

findings.issue: HTTP client retry uses linear backoff (retryDelay * attemptNum) not exponential
findings.impact: Thundering herd on retry for concurrent requests; less effective than exponential backoff with jitter
findings.fix: Implement exponential backoff with jitter: delay = min(baseDelay * 2^attempt + random(0, jitter), maxDelay)

findings.issue: No circuit breaker found wrapping Supabase admin client calls despite circuit-breaker utility existing
findings.impact: Supabase outage causes cascading API failures without circuit breaker protection
findings.fix: Wrap getSupabaseAdmin calls in circuit breaker using the existing executeWithCircuitBreaker utility

findings.issue: No .dockerignore found in repo root or app directories — entire context sent to Docker daemon
findings.impact: Slower builds, larger image cache, risk of leaking .env or node_modules into build context
findings.fix: Create .dockerignore in each app directory or repo root excluding node_modules, .git, .env, dist, coverage

findings.issue: Worker Dockerfile has no HEALTHCHECK directive
findings.impact: Docker daemon cannot determine worker container health; compose uses external API health instead
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --retries=3 CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:4100/healthz || exit 1

findings.issue: LiveKit image uses :latest tag without SHA pinning
findings.impact: Unpredictable version pulls across deployments; no reproducible builds for WebRTC server
findings.fix: Pin livekit/livekit-server to specific SHA digest or semver tag in production compose

findings.issue: Base images use 'node:22-alpine' without SHA digest pinning
findings.impact: Non-reproducible builds — node:22-alpine tag can change without notice
findings.fix: Pin base images to SHA256 digest: node:22-alpine@sha256:<specific_digest>
